CommunityApplications.Profile:
RifleJock's Unraid Community Apps repository.
**Plugins** - Storage Guard — free-space thresholds for array and pools; colors Main free bars and optional Unraid alerts. - Thunderbolt Net — single-link host-to-host networking over Thunderbolt/USB4 (tbn tabs, peers, services, honest link quality).
Docker templates (Neos / Resonite headless) will return later.
Support: https://github.com/ibigsnet/unraid-templates
